subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `AgentTool.outputSchema` become the supported optional public plugin API for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The implementation is broadly coherent and well proven, but shipping this field establishes a compatibility-sensitive plugin contract and trust policy that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve after union fix
options.body: Accept the optional API and trust model after unrenderable unions are forced to unknown and focused regression coverage passes.

options.title: Keep it internal first
options.body: Limit result schemas to core-owned tools until the plugin contract and compatibility expectations have matured.

options.title: Decline result schemas
options.body: Retain raw-first result discovery and avoid adding another public plugin metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after union fix
recommendation.body: Accept the optional API and trust model after unrenderable unions are forced to unknown and focused regression coverage passes.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the current Code Mode execution and catalog-hint architecture that this API extends.
